findings.claim: CLI help and implementation do not need generated-key changes in this slice.
findings.evidence: The CLI calls seedFromConfig directly, which throws an actionable error when private_key is omitted.

findings.claim: Async key generation may create unbounded crypto concurrency.
findings.evidence: The implementation awaits one generateKeyPair call inside a for-of loop, and review confirmed no Promise.all fan-out.

findings.claim: Generated and explicit Apps may reorder generated secrets.
findings.evidence: An interleaved three-App regression test verifies config order and generated-key descriptor order.

exemptions.evidence: CLI key generation and delivery are outside scope, and direct CLI seeding fails explicitly when a key is omitted.

exemptions.claim: Next and Nuxt adapters remain unchanged.
exemptions.evidence: Their direct seed paths require explicit key material; persistence-aware key delivery is a separate contract.
It is local review evidence and is not part of the product diff.
